entries.source: A beautifully soft robe of fine white fur. It looks designed for a halfling noble, with glorious sapphires sewn across the hems. But entrancing as it is, you can't help but feel a little queasy wearing it.
entries.target: 一件由上等白色毛皮制成的长袍，柔软而美丽。它看起来是为半身人贵族设计的，衣边缀满了华美的蓝宝石。尽管它是如此迷人，穿上它时你却忍不住有些恶心。

entries.source: This strange globe of blue light seems to be alive and asleep. Nothing about it moves, yet you can feel the crushing power of its dreams assaulting your mind.
entries.target: 这个奇怪的蓝色光球似乎是活的，而且正在熟睡。它纹丝不动，你却能感受到它梦境中那股压倒性的力量正冲击着你的精神。

entries.source: An invocation portal, perpetually summoning beings through it.
entries.target: 一个召唤传送门，不断地从中召唤出生物。

entries.source: A creature stands before you, with long tentacle-like appendages and a squat bump in place of a head. An intense aura of power radiates from this being unlike anything you've ever felt before. It can only be a Sher'Tul. A living Sher'Tul!
entries.target: 一个生物站在你面前，它有着长长的、类似触须的附肢，头部的位置只有一个矮墩墩的突起。一股强烈的力量从它身上散发出来，与你以往感受过的任何力量都截然不同。它只可能是夏·图尔人。一名活生生的夏·图尔人！
一把莫名湿润的仪式匕首。
不祥的，黑暗符文的法杖

entries.source:
Carved with runes of power, this staff seems to have been made long ago, yet it bears no signs of tarnish.
Light around it seems to dim and you can feel its tremendous power simply by touching it.
The Sorcerers seem to have awakened its power.
#{italic}#"And lo they came to Amakthel himself, and thousands were killed in the assault on his throne, and three of the Godslayers were broken beneath his feet. But Falion with his dying breath pierced the great god on his knee with the icy sword Arkil, and seeing his opportunity Caldizar, leader of the Godslayers, advanced with the Staff of Absorption and struck a terrifying blow against Amakthel. So fell the greatest of the gods by the hands of his own children, and his face was forced into the dust."#{normal}#
entries.target:
杖身铭刻着强大的符文。这根法杖似乎铸造于久远年代，却毫无锈蚀的痕迹。
它周围的光线仿佛也随之暗淡；仅仅触摸它，你就能感受到其中蕴藏的惊人力量。
巫师们似乎已经唤醒了它的力量。
#{italic}#“于是，他们来到阿马克泰尔本人面前。数千人在进攻他的王座时丧生，三名弑神者被碾碎在他脚下。然而，法利恩在临终之际用冰剑阿奇尔刺中了伟大神祇的膝盖。弑神者首领凯尔帝勒抓住机会，手持吸能法杖上前，对阿马克泰尔发动了骇人的一击。众神中最强大的存在就这样倒在自己的儿女手中，脸也被压进尘土。”#{normal}#

entries.source: absorb the essence (ignoring resistance and bypassing most defenses) of a target in range %d, draining 30%% of its life and increasing your own damage by 30%% for %d turns
entries.target: 吸收%d格范围内某个目标生物的精华（无视抗性和大部分防御技能），直接吸收30%%生命值，并增加自身伤害加成30%%，持续%d回合

entries.source: was absorbed by the %s held by %s
A pearl, three times the size of a normal pearl, that glitters in infinite colours, with slight patterns ever shifting away.
entries.target: 一颗有普通珍珠三倍大的珍珠，闪耀着无穷无尽的色彩，细微的花纹不断流转变幻。

entries.source: The rift leads to another floor of the dungeon.
entries.target: 裂缝连接到地图上的另一个楼层。

entries.source: This potent elixir can give insights into martial combat to those unlucky enough to ignore the basics.
entries.target: 这种强大的药剂可以给那些忽视基础的人提供最基本的武学技巧。

entries.source: #VIOLET#You seem to understand the basic martial pratices. (Combat Training talents unlocked)
entries.target: #VIOLET#你似乎理解了一些基础的武术训练。（战斗训练系解锁）

entries.source: #VIOLET#You seem to now know how to properly use a bow or a sling.
entries.target: #VIOLET#你似乎学会了如何使用弓和投石索。

entries.source: #VIOLET#Images of yourself beating people with a stick spring into your mind. (Staff Combat category can be bought)
entries.target: #VIOLET#你用木棒击打他人的画面浮现在你的脑海中。（能购买法杖格斗系）

entries.source: #VIOLET#You suddenly understand how to channel your mental force through mindstars. (Mindstar Mastery category can be bought)
entries.target: #VIOLET#你突然理解如何用灵晶调用精神力量。（能购买灵晶掌握系）

entries.source: #VIOLET#It seems you already knew all the elixir could teach you.
entries.target: #VIOLET#似乎你已经学会了它能教你的一切。

entries.source: This potent elixir extracted from a powerful wyrm can grant the power to repel arcane forces.
entries.target: 这种强大的药剂提取自一头龙的龙胆，可以给予你对抗魔法的力量。

entries.source: Quaffing this potion will grant you access to the antimagic talents but at the cost of all access to runes, arcane items and spells.
entries.target: 喝下这支药剂，可以使你获得反魔技能，代价则是不能使用符文、法术类技能或奥术物品。

entries.source: You cannot use your %s anymore; it is tainted by magic.
entries.target: 你不能再使用 %s，它已被魔法所污染。
